name: freqgen-monorepo
description: Monorepo for TypeScript signal / frequency generator drivers: FeelTech FY-series, JUNTEK & Koolertron, Spooky2 XM and Gen X, over a shared transport/driver core.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @freqgen/core && npm run build -w @freqgen/juntek && npm run build -w @freqgen/spooky2 && npm run build -w @freqgen/feeltech

author: Manuel Haller Polo
